ratings_why.fun: Every card is a little swap story you play out, and boards grow in surprising directions, but a Guised board means reading two texts per unit, which slows the joy.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 over 7: Guise copies the tribe, so a Changeling joins another tribe's synergies, and Exchange sends your own unit back into the shop; no tribe today plays the shop and other tribes as its material.

verdict_why: v3 closed the wording gaps; what's left is UI work on showing a Guise and one small Tam Twice line, not a reason for another full pass.

points.text: The folklore lives in the verbs: Eggshell Brew unmasks, Pip copies mirror-backwards, Penny turns the original away, Stocks are the body left behind. Keep that when numbers change.
A Guised unit carries two texts. Show the copied text on a borrowed-coat strip with the Worn count on it, so the board reads at a glance.
Tam Twice could say "While this is on your board" and whether a Guised unit still counts as a copy of itself too; one clause would settle both.
The Lady's text is a rules paragraph. Move the 'printed means' and 'ignores other Ladies' parts into a reminder line so the card reads 'Has the text of every other unit on your board.'
Keeper of the Lost Hour's Worn transfer is the clearest 'one night under the hill' moment; a visible clock icon moving between units would sell it.

standouts.why: Pip Unlike: one-line rule, pure folklore, and it actually changes how Pass or 'leftmost' cards land.
Penny Second: wear your carry's face and send the real one to the shop, the seed's best story in one card.
Fetch of the Front Rank: you scout the next board and place it across their best unit, a readable plan.

weakest.why: Tam Twice is still the hardest card to read: triples rules, Unmask order and buff transfer in one box.
The Lady is a great idea buried under four lines of exceptions.
Glamour-Veil Seamstress overrides the Guise keyword's 'When played doesn't trigger', so players must hold both rules in mind.

flags.note: Unsaid whether the triples rule works only while Tam is on board, and whether a Guised unit also counts as itself.
Knowe Usher is uncapped per Worn, and Keeper piles Worn onto one unit; one Unmask can buff the whole board hugely.
Several Ladies via Guise or Moll Stocks multiply every buff text; the square growth is bounded only by 7 slots.
